Anja Hohenester-Zimmern its illegal to come to Israel as a tourist with intention to settle, BUT I came here on tourist visa and since beggining i was telling at the airport that me and my israeli partner want start a family and life together, and we are gonna start process in Misrad Hapnim now, when im on tourist visa. We get the lawyer, and we applied for extension my tourist visa, becouse I was waiting for my documents from my home country. As you open process in Misrad Hapnim your tourist visa date is frozen, so you can stay in Israel until MH invite you for first visit and open your case.
So your partner dont need to applied before you came to Israel,  ive heard it takes muuuuch more time with this way, waiting for invitation to Israel sometimes is takes loooong loong months, that you cannot visit your love here in Israel.
